fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (AMZN) rose 11% over the past year, and UBS initiated coverage with a Buy rating and set a price target of $340 (32% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS revenue increased 39% to $4.6 billion in Q3 and accounts for 60% of Amazon's operating income of $2.81 billion, with expectations for over 40% growth in 2027–2028.
